title: Identification with no covering trip, ever
description: Same shape as O12d: no trip is ever run on this asset in this fixture, trip.events is intentionally empty. Must prove: the identification persists unlinked, with no assignee write. Must NOT change: the asset assignee must stay untouched. The metrics-side measurement this case is meant to inform (the gap between the identification and the next trip start, which decides whether the phase-2 trip-start consumer is built) has no field in the Fixture or Scenario types and is out of scope for this fixture; only the row-level outcome is asserted here.

driver_identifications.note: delivered on an asset that never runs a trip in this fixture
